synopsis: The vendor’s current RTX radar uses material-dependent sensor properties, making material configuration relevant to its simulated response [f4533]. It also requires time-aware motion data to calculate Doppler [f4534]. The tools inventory lists one RTX radar model in NVIDIA Isaac Sim, compared with 25 RTX lidar models [f9017]. The facts do not establish whether that listed radar model is the same vendor implementation described in the sensor chapter [f4533, f4534, f9017].
